name: CONTENT-ADMIN-IMAGE-UPLOAD
status: implemented candidate; loopback Content/User/storage fixtures and real OSS SDK against loopback only; real OSS and cross-service integration pending

api.contentType: multipart/form-data with valid boundary; exactly one file part named img
api.compatibility: Existing frontend must let the HTTP client set multipart boundary; its current explicit Content-Type is not modified in this task.

authorization.flow: Verify SDK JWT, authoritative session and admin scope, then revalidate subject and current permissions through fixed User /api/admin/auth/me using the same token on every request.
authorization.failure: Invalid/revoked session 401; scope or permission denied 403; session/User unavailable or malformed 503/code 500. No storage call on auth failure.

validation.file: At most 1048576 bytes; multipart request at most 1114112 bytes including boundaries and headers; at most two parts can be parsed and exactly one img file is accepted. Malformed or missing multipart/part yields 400/code 400; oversized request/file yields 413/code 413.
validation.content: JPEG or PNG identified from bytes, decoded using JDK image readers; PNG chunk CRC and termination checked; JPEG must terminate correctly and decode without warning. Reject invalid/unsupported content with HTTP 200/code 507. Claimed MIME and filename do not determine format.
validation.dimensions: Each side <=4096 and total <=4194304 pixels; image sample format and band count are bounded; no more than two concurrent image validations. Decoder memory remains subject to JDK implementation overhead.
validation.metadata: Original validated bytes are uploaded unchanged, so embedded image metadata such as EXIF is retained. User-supplied filename is never used in the object key or Content-Disposition.

storage.implementation: Aliyun OSS Java SDK 3.18.3, V4 signature, HTTPS and certificate verification. Writes are capped at ten concurrent operations with no queue; an outer five-second deadline and SDK request timeout both apply. Connection-pool wait 500 ms, connect 1500 ms, read 2500 ms; no proxy system properties, redirects or automatic retries.
storage.object: Object key is UTC yyyy/MM/dd plus random UUID and detected .png or .jpg. Upload Content-Type matches bytes, Content-Length is exact and Content-Disposition is inline. Presigned GET URL expires approximately one hour after signing.
storage.failure: Unavailable, disabled, saturated, timed-out or failed storage yields HTTP 503/code 500 with generic message. A timeout/failure after OSS accepted a PUT may leave an orphan object; caller retry is not automatically safe or idempotent.
storage.logs: Do not log object paths, raw request/response, credentials or presigned URLs. Default logging disables com.aliyun.oss and Apache HTTP wire/header logs, and limits MVC response-body logging to INFO; deployments must not re-enable sensitive SDK/wire/body logging.

configuration.KNODE_CONTENT_UPLOAD_ENABLED: false by default; only true/false accepted
configuration.KNODE_CONTENT_UPLOAD_ENDPOINT: required if enabled; exact HTTPS origin https://oss-{region}.aliyuncs.com with no userinfo, port, query or fragment
configuration.KNODE_CONTENT_UPLOAD_REGION: required if enabled; lowercase OSS region identifier matching endpoint
configuration.KNODE_CONTENT_UPLOAD_BUCKET: required if enabled; 3..63 lowercase bucket-name characters
configuration.OSS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: required when enabled; read by the OSS SDK environment provider, never serialized
configuration.OSS_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET: required when enabled; read by the OSS SDK environment provider, never serialized
configuration.startup: Disabled with no configuration starts normally; a valid authorized request gets 503/code 500. Enabled with incomplete or invalid settings or absent SDK credentials fails startup with generic message. No credentials are checked in disabled mode.

verification: Loopback Content HTTP with synthetic signed auth and User fixture; storage stub for HTTP plus the production SDK adapter and synthetic credentials against loopback fake OSS, including redirect/error/timeout and bounded concurrency. No actual OSS, User, Redis, MySQL or VM integration.
deferred: real OSS endpoint, credentials and bucket policy verification
frontend multipart boundary repair under separate ownership
counters, relay, snapshot, homepage and operations APIs
